description: Pull facts out of short synthetic documents supplied in the prompt.

tasks.title: Count error lines
tasks.prompt:
Count the lines whose level is ERROR in this log. Reply with only a JSON object like {"errors": 0}.

2026-03-14 09:00:01 INFO  worker started
2026-03-14 09:00:07 WARN  queue depth high
2026-03-14 09:01:12 ERROR upload failed (timeout)
2026-03-14 09:01:15 INFO  retrying upload
2026-03-14 09:02:40 ERROR upload failed (timeout)
2026-03-14 09:03:02 INFO  upload ok
2026-03-14 09:04:55 ERROR checksum mismatch
2026-03-14 09:05:00 INFO  worker idle
tasks.rubric: Exactly 3 ERROR lines. The reply should be a JSON object.

tasks.title: Invoice fields
tasks.prompt:
From the invoice below return JSON with the keys invoice (string), date (YYYY-MM-DD string) and total (number). JSON only.

INVOICE INV-2041
Issued: 2026-03-14
Bill to: Harbor Supply Co.
Items: 4 x crate liner @ 52.50, 2 x pallet strap @ 136.25
Amount due: 482.50 USD
tasks.rubric: invoice INV-2041, date 2026-03-14, total 482.5. Score down any extra invented fields only mildly.

tasks.title: Who accepted
tasks.prompt:
List the teams that accepted the invite, separated by commas, and nothing else.

Replies to the planning invite:
Cedar - accepted
Maple - declined
Birch - accepted
Willow - tentative
Spruce - accepted
Alder - declined

tasks.title: Earliest deadline
tasks.prompt:
Which task has the earliest deadline? Give the task name and its date.

Task deadlines:
- Draft report: 2026-05-20
- Review budget: 2026-04-08
- Ship update: 2026-06-01
- Book venue: 2026-04-30

tasks.title: Highest stock
tasks.prompt:
Which product has the most stock, and how many units? 

product,stock
widget,140
gasket,95
bracket,310
valve,205

tasks.title: Highest version
tasks.prompt: Which is the highest version number? Compare the numeric parts, not the text. Installed builds: 1.9.3, 1.10.0, 1.2.12, 1.9.30
tasks.rubric: Semantic ordering gives 1.10.0 as highest. 1.9.30 is lower because 9 < 10 in the second part.

tasks.title: Distinct tags
tasks.prompt: How many distinct tags are in this list? alpha, beta, alpha, gamma, beta, delta, alpha

tasks.title: Config to JSON
tasks.prompt:
Convert this configuration into one JSON object, using numbers and booleans where they apply. JSON only.

retries=3
timeout=30
debug=false
